description: Define the AgentRunner TypeScript interface: { id: string, capabilities: { canEdit, canRunShell, supportsStructuredOutput }, run(input: AgentRunInput): Promise<AgentRunResult> }. Define AgentRunInput (task, context, repoPaths, capabilityGrants, timeoutMs) and AgentRunResult (success, summary, branch?, commits?, error?). Implement MockRunner that returns configurable fixed responses — used for all integration tests and E2E flow validation.
title: AgentRunner interface and mock runner
